name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to SC/ST/OBC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage.
benefits: Complete tuition fee waiver + maintenance allowance (up to ₹13,500/yr)

criteria.description: Applicant must currently be a student
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is not enrolled as a student

criteria.description: Applicant must belong to SC, ST, or OBC category
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant category is not SC, ST, or OBC

criteria.description: Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000
criteria.disqualification_reason: Family annual income exceeds ₹2.5 Lakh limit
